The certificate stays clean and unobstructed at the centre — NO stamp on it (the red SOLD stamp arrives as an overlay cutout). Every figure on the squat house rig (large round head, short compact body, dot eyes, one small mouth, NO nose, NO ears, four-digit hands), varied 1820s coats and hats. Fore/mid/background depth, filled edge-to-edge. Flat-cel 2.5D vector house style, even medium-thick #241a12 outline; the only text is the single 'POYAIS' on the certificate banner; no photorealism, no narrator, no logos; 16:9.
